description: This file defines the ServiceContainer class, which manages the lifecycle and dispatcher instances for the service engine within the Apache OFBiz framework. It supports initialization, starting, stopping, and dispatcher management functions.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: A container class that manages service dispatchers within the OFBiz framework. Responsible for initializing, starting, stopping, and caching LocalDispatcher instances, as well as providing methods to retrieve and deregister dispatchers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ServiceContainer with configuration, including loading the dispatcher factory class based on configuration properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service container, currently implemented to return true without additional logic.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service container by shutting down the JobManager and deregistering all dispatchers.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this service container instance.

methods.name: getLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves an existing or creates a new LocalDispatcher for the given dispatcher name and delegator, caching the result.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters the specified dispatcher from the cache and performs any associated cleanup.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes and returns the dispatcher associated with the given name from the cache.

methods.name: getAllDispatcherNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all dispatcher names currently in cache.
